[[File:Opticron.png|thumb|An Opticron droid]]
The '''Opticrons''' were a type of [[Surveillance droid/Legends|Surveillance]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] built by the agents of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] using arcane and exotic technology. Designed as stealth surveillance units, they were tasked with shadowing the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] after the previous Wrath, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], betrayed the Emperor. The Wrath was alerted to the Opticrons' existence on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] by [[Darth Vowrawn]], leading the Wrath to eliminate several of them.
